audit.reasoning: Quote check: the deciding sentence is verbatim at p. 2 ('Suprasegmentals') of the Logan 2003/2004 SIL-PNG Kasua OPD, which we did not hold before and now do (sha1 71ecb55b..). The catalog record carries grade 'carried-secondary' with empty cite/loc even though our earlier survey verify pass had read the typeset PDF; with the PDF now obtained by the project the grade should be raised to primary/typeset-pdf and the locator filled (Logan 2003 OPD, p. 2). Deciding source: a first-hand SIL OPD sheet by the field linguist (data 1991-93, checked 2003) - primary but minimal (one hedged sentence). Best-available check: Glottolog lists three descriptive works, all by Logan; I downloaded the two that are open (1994 Grammar Essentials, 116 pp scanned, SIL archives 92219; 2007 Grammar Sketch, 40 pp) and both are silent on word stress - the 1994 phonology chapter explicitly defers to the OPD.
